verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the logo's color treatment and its applicability beyond the truck to the broader business.
The client specifies concrete visual revisions to the colors, typography, flame letterform, word sizing, and strapline treatment.
Target-specific implementation claim after the freelancer reports applying the identified visual-design feedback to revised designs.
The client selects concept 4 and changes its rendered color and characterful-letterform treatment; the removed exploratory keys existed and are superseded by this selection.
Target-specific implementation claim describing two revised letterform options designed to add character while preserving logo readability and balance.
The client specifies concrete letter-height and letterform changes for the selected logo option, with cleanliness and character as acceptance conditions.
The client selects rev4-02 as the final logo and specifies its primary rendered color treatment; the removed selection keys existed and are superseded by the final-version selection.
First concrete verification: after viewing the produced design, the client accepts the specifically identified rev4-02 visual version for final use.
